Definition: Jehozabad, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehozabad = "Jehovah has endowed"; 1) son of Shomer, a Moabitish woman, who murdered Joash, king of Judah; 2) a Benjamite, captain of 180,000 armed men, in the days of Jehoshaphat; 3) a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David
